english: In my opinion, education is the key to success.
chinese: 在我看来，教育是成功的关键。
soundmark: /ɪn maɪ əˈpɪnjən ˌedʒuˈkeɪʃn ɪz ðə kiː tuː səkˈses/

english: There is no doubt that hard work pays off.
chinese: 毫无疑问，努力会有回报。
soundmark: /ðeər ɪz nəʊ daʊt ðæt hɑːrd wɜːrk peɪz ɒf/

english: It is widely believed that practice makes perfect.
chinese: 人们普遍认为熟能生巧。
soundmark: /ɪt ɪz ˈwaɪdli bɪˈliːvd ðæt ˈpræktɪs meɪks ˈpɜːrfɪkt/

english: As far as I am concerned, nothing is more important than health.
chinese: 就我而言，没有什么比健康更重要。
soundmark: /æz fɑːr æz aɪ æm kənˈsɜːrnd ˈnʌθɪŋ ɪz mɔːr ɪmˈpɔːrtnt ðæn helθ/

grammar.label: 观点表达
grammar.text: As far as I am concerned,...

english: On the one hand, technology brings convenience.
soundmark: /ɒn ðə wʌn hænd tekˈnɒlədʒi brɪŋz kənˈviːniəns/

english: On the other hand, it may cause problems.
chinese: 另一方面，它可能带来问题。
soundmark: /ɒn ðə ˈʌðər hænd ɪt meɪ kɔːz ˈprɒbləmz/

english: To sum up, we should take action immediately.
chinese: 总之，我们应该立即采取行动。
soundmark: /tuː sʌm ʌp wiː ʃʊd teɪk ˈækʃn ɪˈmiːdiətli/

english: Last but not least, we need everyone's support.
chinese: 最后但同样重要的是，我们需要每个人的支持。
soundmark: /lɑːst bʌt nɒt liːst wiː niːd ˈevriwʌnz səˈpɔːrt/

english: It goes without saying that education matters.
soundmark: /ɪt ɡəʊz wɪˈðaʊt ˈseɪɪŋ ðæt ˌedʒuˈkeɪʃn ˈmætərz/

english: From my perspective, learning never stops.
chinese: 从我的角度看，学习永无止境。

english: The reason why I study English is that I want to communicate globally.
chinese: 我学英语的原因是我想要全球交流。
soundmark: /ðə ˈriːzn waɪ aɪ ˈstʌdi ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ɪz ðæt aɪ wɒnt tuː kəˈmjuːnɪkeɪt ˈɡləʊbəli/

english: For instance, reading English books can help a lot.
chinese: 例如，读英文书可以有很大帮助。
soundmark: /fɔːr ˈɪnstəns ˈriːdɪŋ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ bʊks kæn help ə lɒt/

english: Taking everything into account, I believe we can succeed.
chinese: 综合考虑，我相信我们能成功。
soundmark: /ˈteɪkɪŋ ˈevriθɪŋ ˈɪntuː əˈkaʊnt aɪ bɪˈliːv wiː kæn səkˈsiːd/

english: It is never too old to learn.
soundmark: /ɪt ɪz ˈnevər tuː əʊld tuː lɜːrn/

english: Where there is a will, there is a way.
soundmark: /weər ðeər ɪz ə wɪl ðeər ɪz ə weɪ/
